name: maybe_Battle_PartySlots_NotifyChanged
summary: Assigns an actor to a free menu slot and, in 3D battle mode, refreshes the slot and constructs a 4x8-byte 0xFF-filled record array; called from party window refresh, target marker update and member visibility code.
evidence: Callers Ui_BattlePartyWindow_RefreshMembers/Battle_TargetMarker_Update/Battle_ActionUi_UpdateMemberVisibility; callees Menu_AssignActorToFreeSlot, std_ConstructArray, and 3D-mode check at battle+0x4244.

name: maybe_Battle_RunTargetSelection
summary: Walks the battle party list at battle+0x4260, picks the first unit with state 1 and the first unit whose vtable+0x80 returns 1, then invokes Battle_SelectTargetsThunk; only caller is Menu_AssignActorToFreeSlot.
evidence: Callee Battle_SelectTargetsThunk plus party list walk at +0x4260; single caller Menu_AssignActorToFreeSlot.

name: maybe_Menu_ResolveActorTarget
signature: u32 maybe_Menu_ResolveActorTarget(MenuState * self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
summary: Builds a 0x2F8-byte scratch record (4x8-byte 0xFF-filled array) used to resolve a default target for an actor being placed in a panel slot; called from Menu_AssignActorToFreeSlot and battle UI refresh paths.
evidence: Body is only std_ConstructArray of 0xFF array; callers Menu_AssignActorToFreeSlot and battle UI refresh; return used as slot target.

name: Event_ActivateRecordHandles
summary: Iterates the 0x0C-byte records in [eventState->f_2F8, f_2FC), validates each record's handle at +4 via Field_HandleIsValid and marks the record active (u8_02=1); returns 1.
evidence: Loop over 0x0C-stride records calling Field_HandleIsValid and setting +2=1; five Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene* callers.

name: maybe_Ui_JockeyPanel_UpdatePreviewSlots
summary: If a preview object is attached at +0x124, re-runs the part slot transforms, then returns the shared UI core value at (work+8)->f_88.
evidence: Calls maybe_Ui_Part_UpdateSlotTransforms on self->previewObject and returns (work+8)->f_88; callers Battle_SetActorEffectId and Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene3.

name: Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_UpdateEffectsC
summary: Vtable slot 15 of the battle member widget: computes the member's effect transform, creates scaled effect 0x450, plays the member's effect SE and, when the record has an effect id at +0x92, creates the keyed effect instance and stores the handle at self[0x49E].
evidence: Uses self[0x49D]/self[0x49E] handles, Effect_CreateScaledInstance(0x450), Sound_PlaySeById, and record +0x92 effect id; no direct callers (vtable slot).

name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_Init
summary: Initialises an actor action: clears state/timers, snapshots the actor transform into f_54 and copies the bone/attachment transform blocks (+0x5F4 of the current part, default identity) into f_78..f_A4.
evidence: Clears actionTimer/turnAngleDelta, copies transform matrices from actor part +0x5F4 or identity; only caller Field_ActorAction_TurnStart.

name: Field_Actor_SpawnEffectInstance
summary: Marks a field model actor initialised, selects keyed-list entry 0, and if flag +0x3AA is set spawns attached effect 0x4AD via Effect_FindOrCreateInstance, storing the handle at +0x314.
evidence: Sets maybe_initialised=1, Container_KeyedList_SelectEntry(self->maybe_keyedList,0), and Effect_FindOrCreateInstance(...,0x4AD,...) stored at +0x314.

name: maybe_Field_Object2D_PlayStateEffect
signature: void maybe_Field_Object2D_PlayStateEffect(Field_Object2D* self, int state, u32 arg3, float arg4)
summary: Forwards a state command to the model interface and, for states 10/11, releases the old state effect and spawns effect 0x4B5 at the object position.
evidence: No callers; state switch and effect id 0x4B5 clear but class attribution unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_BeginEffectState
summary: Clears a flag and either spawns effect 0x45C at the actor position (setting orientation) or plays animation 0x0032DD6C.
evidence: No callers; effect id 0x45C and vtable calls present but 'begin effect state' semantics unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_PlaySituationEffect
summary: Sets a busy flag and spawns one of five situation effects (0x4CF..0x4D9) selected by the actor type byte at +0x2E5.
evidence: Only caller is itself a maybe_; effect id switch and busy flag clear but caller semantics unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromDescMesh2
summary: Descriptor-driven sprite actor initialiser: applies transform, adds child/colour animator, creates mesh and loads effect pack 0x69C.
evidence: No named callers or callees; descriptor layout and effect pack id present but ordinal '2' unverified.

name: maybe_Effect_MeshEmitter_SetupD
summary: Copies position from the definition, sets the visible flag, applies Euler rotation and creates the mesh from the u16 id at def+6.
evidence: Only caller is a maybe_ spawn-block; body shape matches mesh-emitter family but slot letter D unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Field_MultiPart_InitFromLayout
summary: Initialises a multi-part field object from a layout record: copies position/rotation/scale and sets up child part offsets and sprite actors.
evidence: Only caller is a maybe_ spawn-block; neighbours confirm multi-part init but four-part count inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_Prop_UpdateChildEffects
summary: Per-frame prop update: re-creates the child effect when the slot id changes, walks child model slots, applies layout params and plays the slot SE.
evidence: Shares all confident callees with 0x004E3714 (Ui_Prop family) but callers are both maybe_ battle UI functions.

name: maybe_Svc_Object_InitFromReader
signature: int maybe_Svc_Object_InitFromReader(void* self, Reader* reader, int poolCountA, int poolCountB, u32 arg5, u32 capacity, int wantData)
summary: Initialises a service object from a random-access reader: reads the 0x28-byte header, validates capacity, builds two block pools and sends the service init request.
evidence: Callers Gfx_CreateChannel and Svc_Object_CreateFromDescriptor support service-object init, but exact semantics of the reader/pool layout remain uncertain.

name: maybe_Svc_Object_CreateWithPayload
signature: int maybe_Svc_Object_CreateWithPayload(u32* outSize, u32 packed, u32 low, u32 forwarded, int count1, int count2, int withHeader)
summary: Sends a create request (header 0x0004008C) via Gfx_IpcCmd803, allocates a pool node with the vtable-0x00780EAC family, optionally queries a 0x28-byte header, and returns count1*0x20 + count2*0x18 payload size in *outSize.
evidence: Body uses unaff_r9 (damaged decompilation) and the only caller is Svc_Object_CreateSimple; the 0x0004008C header, Gfx_IpcCmd803 and Mem_PoolAllocNode support a create-with-payload path but the unaff_ register and missing disassembly prevent a confident name.

name: maybe_Gfx_ProcessFrame
summary: Per-frame service loop of the graphics/audio IPC library: services retrace/should-close callbacks, handles command-ring entries (kinds 2/5/8/9) and runs the render state machine over the callback table at 0x007AE954.
evidence: Callers Gfx_UpdateDisplayState and Gfx_ServiceDisplayTransfer; callees split into Gfx IPC (WriteGpuBuffer/ReadGpuBuffer/IpcCmdF0100Query/IpcCmd3F0040Call) and Snd (SetMasterEnable/FlushChannels); body is a callback-driven state machine.

name: maybe_Gfx_InitInterrupts
summary: Clears the caller's flag byte and, when the incoming zero flag allows, arms interrupt sources via 0x00113A40(3) and programs locked command 0x3E0080.
evidence: Damaged decompilation (in_ZR, unaff_r4); 21 callers across IPC/display/input paths; only named callee Gfx_LockedIpcCmd3E0080.

name: maybe_Script_ReadArg1Number
summary: Inlined read-argument-1-as-number fragment of Script_Native_TokenizeString at 0x0014872C; reads stack slot 1, accepts the 0x4000003 float tag and converts to int. Not a real entry point.
evidence: No callers; enclosing prologue is Script_Native_TokenizeString; first instruction bl sq_getstackobj with index vm+0x34+1; body is damaged (unaff_r4/r5/r6).

name: maybe_Script_ReadArg2Number
summary: Inlined read-argument-2-as-number fragment of the same Squirrel native at 0x0014872C, identical to 0x00148780 but reading index vm+0x34+2. Not a real entry point.
evidence: Only caller is 0x00148780; same sq_getstackobj + 0x4000003 float-tag sequence; no prologue of its own; body damaged.

name: maybe_Ui_BattleCmd_HandleTargetMove
summary: Target-selection movement step: when the input mask at self+0x4C has movement bits and the cursor is enabled, plays the move SE, recomputes screen positions (f_E4/f_E8) of the selected party member and its actor slot, then refreshes the command widget via vtable +0x50.
evidence: Callees Sound_PlaySeById, Ui_PartyStatusWindow_GetSelectedMemberId, Ui_Widget_CountChildren; member-record f_e4/f_e8 writes; input mask 0x106/0x102 checks.

name: FieldParty_PlayMemberItemSe
signature: int maybe_FieldParty_PlayMemberItemSe(void* group, void* actor, int slot)
summary: Plays a sound id for a party member: resolves the member from the actor's character id, reads the equipped item of the given hand (func_006292F0), and plays the SE stored in that item's data row (f_be); falls back to the character row's f_aa sound when no item is equipped.
evidence: Callees Item_LookupRecord, func_006292F0, func_0063DF9C row f_be, func_0063FDAC row f_aa, Sound_PlaySeById; member resolved via func_0035EB98.

name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_UpdateDrawPos
summary: Recomputes a 2D sprite's screen rectangle: takes sprite size from its model record, divides by 8, adds the actor's +0x78/+0x7C draw offset, builds the transform through 0x0031A658 and submits the rectangle for drawing when the debug flag +0x29D or 0x00669B98 allows it.
evidence: Size/8 arithmetic, two transform calls, clipping bounds; callees Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh, Actor_TryPlayActionSeq16, func_00669B98; visibility flag check.

name: maybe_Ui_BattleCmd_HandleSecondaryInput
summary: Second input branch of the battle command window: on the confirm bit it plays SE 0 and constructs a 4x8-byte command array with the 0xFF none marker; on the cancel bit it runs the no-op step, refreshes the widget and pushes command id 0x10.
evidence: Same input-guard pattern as its siblings; no caller identifies the owning window or the meaning of command 0x10; std_ConstructArray with 0xFF marker and SE 0 are the only concrete facts.

name: maybe_Ui_BattleCmd_HandleCommandSelect
signature: u32 maybe_Ui_BattleCmd_HandleCommandSelect(int* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
summary: Battle command-window select step: refreshes the member widget and window, and when the confirm bit is set checks Battle_Item_CanTargetActor, builds the command for the highlighted slot with maybe_Ui_BattleCmd_ConstructCommands, advances the command script to 0x12 and plays the confirm SE; the cancel bit forwards the stored command id.
evidence: Battle_Item_CanTargetActor and maybe_Ui_BattleCmd_ConstructCommands are named; script state 0x12 and slot byte at self+0x40A+slot*8 are concrete, but no caller identifies the menu stage.

name: maybe_Ui_BattleCmd_HandleCommandConfirm
signature: u32 maybe_Ui_BattleCmd_HandleCommandConfirm(int* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
summary: Confirm branch of the battle command window: on the confirm bit it sends the selected member id to the state machine, reads the highlighted command id through vtable +0x44 and, unless it is 0x1A (back), pushes it into the command script and plays the confirm SE; the cancel bit pushes command 0xB.
evidence: Ui_PartyStatusWindow_GetSelectedMemberId and the 0x1A special case are concrete, but no caller identifies which menu stage invokes it.

name: maybe_Field_Object_UpdateSeState
summary: Starts or stops the object's looping SE depending on its linked record: when the record's first u16 is 0x9DB it restarts SE 4, otherwise it plays SE 4 only when the animation id changed; then stores state byte f_2BA and forwards the command to the scene-node children.
evidence: Data-manager record compare against 0x9DB and two Sound_PlaySeById(4,...) calls with opposite loop flags are visible, but the Thumb body has damaged registers (unaff_r4/r6/r7/r9, in_ZR).

name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_PlayIdleAnim
summary: Starts the sprite's idle animation when nothing else is playing: if the two state bytes f_29B/f_29D are clear it plays the id from g_001A4CD0 through Anim_PlayByIdForActor and marks f_29B, otherwise it tells the object to finish state 4.
evidence: Anim_PlayByIdForActor is named and the guard bytes are explicit, but 'idle' is an inference from the fixed animation id and the 0x100 sound cue; only caller Field_SceneObject_SpawnByTypeB does not confirm intent.

name: maybe_FieldParty_PlayMemberVoiceId
signature: unsigned maybe_FieldParty_PlayMemberVoiceId(void* work, Actor* actor, void* arg3, int force)
summary: Chooses and plays a sound id for an actor from its category code: -0x13/-0x14 play 0x15C, -4/-0x19 play 0x131, -5/-0x1A play 0x132, -0x12 is silent and other values play 0x129/0x12A depending on whether the actor is a party member; positive categories also branch on param byte +0x26 and force.
evidence: Category ladder and direct Sound_PlaySeById calls are clear, and the monster test goes through Text_Row_IsMonsterType, but the ids are plain SE ids rather than proven voice ids.

name: maybe_FieldParty_SelectMemberVoiceById
signature: void maybe_FieldParty_SelectMemberVoiceById(unsigned arg1, Actor* actor, void* arg3, int force)
summary: Second variant of the member sound selector: chooses 0x15C/0x15A/0x15D for the character categories and, when not forced, reads the sound id from the character record (u16 at +200) fetched by the actor's character id; always ends by playing the chosen id.
evidence: Character-record lookup func_0063E5C8(actor->f_768) with the u16 at +200 is a concrete data source, but 0x15A/0x15C/0x15D are not proven voice ids.

name: maybe_Ui_CreditWindow_SelectGroupAndPlaySe
summary: Credit-window helper: selects the next pane group through Ui_CreditWindow_SelectPaneGroup and plays SE 0xE56.
evidence: The only named callee, Ui_CreditWindow_SelectPaneGroup, places this in the credit window; the 64-byte body does nothing else, but the caller and the group-select argument are still not visible.

name: maybe_Ui_PlayConfirmSeIfFlagged
signature: void maybe_Ui_PlayConfirmSeIfFlagged(UiWidget* self, int arg2, int arg3, void* ctxOut)
summary: If the widget flag byte at +0x296 is set, plays SE 9 through the shared sound player; otherwise does nothing.
evidence: Only caller is Field_SceneObject_OnConfirm; body is a flag test plus Sound_PlaySeById(9). 'Confirm' is an interpretation of SE 9, not proven.

name: maybe_Ui_PlayConfirmSeIfFlaggedB
signature: void maybe_Ui_PlayConfirmSeIfFlaggedB(UiWidget* self, int arg2, int arg3, void* ctxOut)
summary: Same body as 0x0028E46C but tests flag byte +0x2C7; plays SE 9 when set.
evidence: Identical structure to 0x0028E46C with offset +0x2C7; sole caller Field_SceneObject_OnConfirmB. Confirm semantics inherited, unproven.

name: maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_HandleTextInput
signature: void maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_HandleTextInput(void* self, u16* charPtr, u32 glyphSource, int flag)
summary: Damaged, truncated body: looks up a record for the typed character and forwards glyph helpers; the rest is lost to halt_baddata.
evidence: No callers; body truncated by bad instruction data with unaff_r6; the equip-window owner and text-input behaviour are unverified.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_PlaySeA
signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_PlaySeA(void* self, BattleActor* actor, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Plays the actor's animation SE (actor+0xB8), then either SE 0x158 or 0x15D depending on a member flag, unless battle mode redirects to a vtable slot.
evidence: Sound calls visible but Thumb body damaged (unaff_r5/r6/r9); no callers; widget class unnamed.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_PlaySeB
summary: Plays the widget's SE id from record+0xBA and then the same 0x158/0x15D fallback path as 0x003CC250.
evidence: Only the sound call and virtual dispatch are identifiable; damaged Thumb body with unaff registers; no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_Part_PlaySe50WhenThrottled
summary: Timed part update: forwards to a child vtable slot and, while a latch is set and a timer predicate holds with a value above 8.0f, plays SE 0x32 once and clears the latch.
evidence: SE id 0x32 and 8.0f threshold are literal; no callers; part class and 'throttled' meaning unproven.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_PlaySoundAtLocator
summary: No dossier available; name retained as-is.
evidence: No readable file or dossier; cannot verify.

name: maybe_FieldParty_PlayCommonSe
summary: Gets the shared sound player and plays SE 300 with no extra arguments; a shared helper called from battle, text-window and field-party code.
evidence: Body is only Sound_GetPlayer + Sound_PlaySeById(300); 10 callers across battle, text and field subsystems, so the field-party attribution is not supported.

name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_CommitScene
summary: Damaged decompilation (unaff_r4/unaff_r5, in_s16) of a scene-flow commit that initialises scene sprite set and scene, binds event natives, loads world-map models and advances flow counter +0x1D; arguments are lost so the exact contract is unclear.
evidence: Body uses unaff_r4/unaff_r5 and in_s16 (damaged decompilation per project rule); named callees Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_Init, Gfx_Scene_Init, Event_Script_BindAllNatives, Ui_SceneFlow_LoadWorldMapModels support a scene-flow commit but the owner/args are not recoverable.

name: maybe_Ui_Widget_Reset
summary: Short reset of a UI window: clears +0xF2, clears slot 0x53 unless battle mode byte +0x4248 is 1, calls vtable +0x20 and clears f_3F; called from Gfx_Scene_Init.
evidence: Only caller is Gfx_Scene_Init; body is a generic field reset with an undeclared arg4, so the owning class remains a generic widget.
